title: Helping NSFs with Mental Conditions Link Up with External Health and Social Sector Partners for Better Care
what_it_is: Helping NSFs with Mental Conditions Link Up with External Health and Social Sector Partners for Better Care

sections.label: SAF support for NSFs
sections.summary: The SAF identifies NSFs with psychosocial stressors through touchpoints like Basic Military Training, surveys and commander interviews, and provides support or referrals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: To the Member's question, in addition to the SAF's mental health support systems, the SAF has measures to support NSFs who face psychosocial stressors that may impact their mental health.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: These NSFs are identified through various touchpoints during their service, such as the Basic Military Training, through surveys and regular commander interviews.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Where needed, their commanders will provide them support or refer them to relevant services.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: These include the SAF's financial assistance schemes, counselling as well as rehabilitation services.

sections.label: Continuity of support after NS
sections.summary: It works with MSF's Social Service Offices and Family Service Centres to ensure continuity of support for NSFs after they complete National Service.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: For example, it works with the Ministry of Social and Family Development's Social Service Offices, and the community network of Family Service Centres to help those with added needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: So, doing so ensures the continuity of support for our NSFs after they complete National Service (NS).

sections.label: Case Connect pilot with MSF
sections.summary: MINDEF is piloting Case Connect with MSF and social service offices to manage cases jointly, and will study better integration with the public health system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: Today, with the Ministry of Social and Family Development and the social service offices, the Ministry of Defence (MINDEF) is piloting Case Connect, where there is a direct link between our officers of medical health professionals as well the social service offices, in terms of being able to manage cases jointly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But certainly, I will take it back to MINDEF to study how we can also integrate better with the public health system for professionals like yourselves, who can also provide feedback back into the system.
